mapper.select: SELECT g.id, g.name, a.name AS attrName, g.number, g.spec, c.name AS categoryName, g.brand, g.unit, g.code, g.`data` AS data, COALESCE(SUM(r.nums), 0) AS totalStock FROM goods g LEFT JOIN category c ON g.category = c.id LEFT JOIN attr a ON g.id = a.pid LEFT JOIN room r ON r.goods = g.id AND (a.id IS NULL OR r.attr = a.name OR r.attr = a.id OR r.attr IS NULL OR r.attr = '') GROUP BY g.id, g.name, g.number, g.spec, g.brand, g.unit, g.code, g.data, c.name, a.name ORDER BY g.name, a.name
